metadata.name: Aerosol Particle Size Distribution Measurements at Neumayer Station, Antarctica (2019)
metadata.description: Time-series dataset containing aerosol particle number concentration measurements across 63 size bins (92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm) collected at Neumayer Station III, Antarctica, throughout the year 2019. The data includes particle size distributions (dN/dlogDp) measured at 7 meters height, with timestamps and measurement durations, capturing atmospheric aerosol dynamics including New Particle Formation events.
metadata.spatial: Point measurement at fixed location (Neumayer Station III, Antarctica)
